title: Isolated staging and controlled production promotion
goal: Separate staging and production infrastructure and allow production promotion only for an approved, fully verified release SHA

in: Separate Vercel and Supabase staging and production projects
Domain aliases, GitHub environments, scoped secrets, protected promotion, and deployment evidence

acceptance_criteria: demo.tourify.live resolves only to isolated staging and tourify.live/www resolve only to production
Staging and production databases, credentials, deployment IDs, and release SHA are demonstrably isolated
Production deployment cannot bypass required CI, E2E, security, or manual approval gates
Each deployment records its Git SHA, environment, migration evidence, deployment ID, and approver

evidence: Audit baseline: tourify.live and demo.tourify.live resolve to the same Vercel production deployment and project.
Audit baseline: GitHub environments have no scoped secrets or protection and main has no branch protection; Vercel deployed the live main SHA despite failing CI.

progress.summary: Partial batch implementation landed: deploy-demo was converted to an explicit exact-SHA staging workflow with environment-scoped project variables, successful CI/E2E/security checks, topology validation, prebuilt deployment, and deployment evidence artifacts. Hosted projects and credentials were not provisioned.
completed: Removed automatic workflow_run staging deployment and made staging dispatch require release SHA, migration evidence, and approval reference.
Added exact-SHA, matching workflow-run, topology, prebuilt deployment, and evidence-artifact steps.
next_steps: Provision separate Vercel/Supabase staging and production projects, domains, scoped secrets, and protected GitHub environments.
Run the staging workflow with real credentials and record deployment ID, release SHA, migration evidence, and approver.
blockers: No authorized Vercel, Supabase, DNS, or GitHub environment credentials are available in this workspace; hosted isolation is unverified.
The current live production/demo domains still share the existing deployment until the workflow is run against separate projects.
